description: Compare two to eight FAA NASR facilities on one consistent 28-day source cycle. Ranks by longest published runway and compares runway count/dimensions, hard-surface and lighted counts, ILS and approach-light runway ends, tower/FAR 139 codes, status/use, identifiers, and provenance. Use this for 'compare JFK, LAX, and ORD runway capabilities' or 'which shortlisted airport has the longest runway and ILS-equipped ends?'. It is a technical evidence view, not an operational suitability decision or navigation source.

airports.description: Two to eight FAA location ids, ICAO ids, site numbers, or unambiguous names.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: faa_public_aviation_compare_airports
